border.description: Draw a border around the paragraph, in this colour.

dropCap.description: Drop cap: the first letter is enlarged over this many lines (2 to 10).

noLineNumbers.description: Leave this paragraph out of the line numbers (its lines are not counted).

dir.description: Writing direction: rtl for Arabic, Hebrew…; left out, it follows the text.

kind.description: What the block was: a paragraph or a heading.

level.description: Heading level, if it was a heading.

style.description: Paragraph style, if it had one.
